About the job

Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.Life as a Sprinter -Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.The mission -Where you'll leave your mark?      Own quality outcomes, not activities — the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint," it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it."Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there — the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual interventionOwn bug leakage rate — target under 2-3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets throughBuild the system that keeps flaky tes

personal_details.label: Senior SDET | API & UI Automation | Java · Python · Microservices
personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: PNR Linking & SSR [REST Assured · ReadyAPI · BDD · AiDE] : Architected automation frameworks for airline domain; built 1000+ test cases cutting effort from 750 to 50 man-hours (93% reduction).
Order Bags [REST Assured · AiDE · E2E] : Leveraged Agentic AI (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated Kibana log analysis, issue reporting, and data quality validation pipelines; eliminated manual intervention and saved 12 hrs/week of QA overhead.
Drove shift-left testing practices using Azure DevOps and BDD Cucumber, reducing bug leakage to production across 3 airline microservice domains.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
